visual_review.notes: Reviewed all992 original extracted frames chronologically, enlarged pike tips/grips/alpha edges, attack and death joins, all296 selected native phases and eight retained idle poses, plus three offscreen candidate battle renders. Reciprocal gait, dedicated recoil/recovery, held low guard, physical grip-adjustment support, corrected rigid-pike thrust and continuous kneel/side-fall retain identity, scale and grounding. Initial stretched attack and abrupt death rotation excluded; originals preserved. Candidate focused Windows checks980 pass, zero failures. Review used complete chronological frames and native phase renders, not continuous playback or a manual playtest.
